name: Funagata (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Funagata town emblem in white: an outlined lozenge enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Funagata, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 May 1955.

features.role: Funagata town emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a ring with a stylised character
